Other values sit slightly beyond the document's ranges but in the same direction: top-1 agreement 0.828, KL 0.432, cosine 0.835. The mid-layer size ratio of 0.973 is also close to the 0.976-0.981 range. Three refusals dropped is consistent with the 0-4 range.
